versions.changelog: No changes detected in this version.

- Initial release of the famou-artifact-generator skill.
- Guides users through the full FaMou evolutionary task process: clarification, task definition (problem.md), artifact implementation (init.py, evaluator.py, prompt.md), and verification.
- Structured two-stage workflow: (1) clarifying with structured Q&A and TODO tracking, (2) step-by-step artifact generation and automated validation.
- Triggers on any user intent related to defining, clarifying, or creating FaMou tasks, or preparing/optimizing experiment artifacts, even from vague or minimal prompts.
- Strictly enforces phased clarification, completeness checks, and self-contained artifact validation before finalization.
